problem_restatement: V58 has two BTC short-only Hulk routes and one sparse downside-sweep long route, leaving ordinary bullish BTC participation uncovered. Qualify a materially new point-in-time source before defining or testing another long candidate.

official_contract.direction_semantics: taker direction for ordinary public trades
official_contract.historical_database_update_lag: approximately five seconds after a trade

hyperliquid_market_source.boundary_diagnosis: The identical credential and request shape succeed on and after 2025-03-01 but reproducibly fail on and before 2025-02-28. An external historical-boundary limitation is the leading explanation; the vendor error body is not exposed by the current secret-safe client.
hyperliquid_market_source.boundary_diagnosis_falsifier: A successful request before 2025-03-01 with the same endpoint and account, or vendor documentation identifying a different request defect, invalidates the boundary inference.

mechanism_distinction.new_input: signed taker-initiated BTC option transactions separated by call versus put and moneyness
mechanism_distinction.distinct_from_rejected_dvol: DVOL is an aggregate implied-volatility level without intrinsic direction; this source exposes transaction direction, option type, strike, expiry, amount, and event-time index price.
mechanism_distinction.distinct_from_rejected_price_and_flow_fa: The source originates on Deribit options rather than Hyperliquid price, funding, liquidation, public trade, or L2 data.
mechanism_distinction.support_interpretation: Published evidence makes option directional flow plausible, not profitable in this implementation. The same literature reports that volatility-motivated trading can dominate directional information, so empirical falsification remains required.

known_failure_modes: Public direction is taker direction for ordinary trades, but block-trade direction semantics differ; block and RFQ trades must be excluded.
Combo legs can look directional while representing a delta-neutral structure; combo-identified trades must be excluded.
Trade IV is simultaneous event data and can be noisy or stale; invalid or nonpositive IV must fail validation.
The historical API exposes event time but not bitemporal receipt or revision history.
Daily responses can exceed 10000 trades; acquisition must split bounded windows until has_more is false rather than truncating.
The 0xArchive source may contain minute gaps; full cadence must be measured and material gaps must fail closed.
Source density does not establish predictive value, after-cost profitability, or live execution feasibility.
next_action: Preregister exactly one causal option-directional-flow strategy and its source, partition, cost, delay, concentration, and acceptance contracts before full source acquisition.
